title: Paeoniflorin Ameliorates Osteoarthritis via Ring Finger Protein 216/Optineurin-Mediated Autophagy Activation in Chondrocytes.
authors: Peng, Cheng; Jiang, Ding; Gao, Ningyang; Zheng, Yuxin; Xu, Haitao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芍药苷通过RNF216/OPTN轴激活自噬改善骨关节炎，属于纯疾病机制与药物研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a prevalent degenerative joint disorder. Paeoniflorin (PF), a primary bioactive compound from Paeonia lactiflora roots, demonstrates therapeutic potential for OA. This study investigated the effects and mechanisms of PF in OA. In vitro, an OA model was established using interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta)-treated chondrocytes. In vivo, an OA mouse model was generated via destabilization of the medial meniscus (DMM). Molecular docking, bioinformatics analysis, and experimental validation identified ring finger protein 216 (RNF216) as a PF target. RNF216 overexpression and optineurin (OPTN) overexpression were achieved via genetic manipulation. Autophagy was evaluated by Western blot, transmission electron microscopy, and monomeric red fluorescent protein (mRFP)-green fluorescent protein (GFP)-microtubule-associated protein 1A/1B-light chain 3 (LC3) reporter. PF attenuated chondrocyte injury in vitro and alleviated OA progression in vivo. Through molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), we identified carbonic anhydrase IX (CAIX, CA9) as a direct target of PF. RNF216 overexpression abolished PF's chondroprotective effects, which were rescued by OPTN overexpression. The autophagy inhibitor 3-methyladenine (3-MA) blocked PF-mediated chondroprotection via the RNF216/OPTN axis. Mechanistically, PF inhibited RNF216-dependent ubiquitination and degradation of OPTN, enhancing autophagic flux to mitigate cartilage damage. PF alleviates OA by suppressing RNF216-mediated OPTN ubiquitination, stabilizing OPTN to activate autophagy and protect chondrocytes. These findings highlight PF as a promising therapeutic agent for OA.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种常见的退行性关节疾病。芍药苷（PF）是芍药根中的主要生物活性化合物，对OA具有治疗潜力。本研究探讨了PF在OA中的作用及机制。在体外实验中，使用白细胞介素-1β（IL-1beta）处理的软骨细胞建立了OA模型。在体内实验中，通过内侧半月板失稳（DMM）构建了OA小鼠模型。分子对接、生物信息学分析和实验验证确定了环指蛋白216（RNF216）为PF的靶点。通过基因操作实现了RNF216过表达和optineurin（OPTN）过表达。自噬通过Western blot、透射电子显微镜和单体红色荧光蛋白（mRFP）-绿色荧光蛋白（GFP）-微管相关蛋白1A/1B-轻链3（LC3）报告基因进行评估。PF在体外减轻了软骨细胞损伤，并在体内缓解了OA进展。通过分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA），我们确定碳酸酐酶IX（CAIX，CA9）为PF的直接靶点。RNF216过表达消除了PF的软骨保护作用，而OPTN过表达则恢复了该作用。自噬抑制剂3-甲基腺嘌呤（3-MA）通过RNF216/OPTN轴阻断了PF介导的软骨保护。机制上，PF抑制了RNF216依赖性的OPTN泛素化和降解，增强自噬通量以减轻软骨损伤。PF通过抑制RNF216介导的OPTN泛素化，稳定OPTN以激活自噬并保护软骨细胞，从而缓解OA。这些发现突显了PF作为OA治疗药物的潜力。
